description: This PHP source file contains functions related to obtaining and processing remote viewer data, including IP address handling, proxy detection, reverse DNS lookup, geolocation info, and IP anonymization, used within the Revive Adserver delivery engine.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostSetInfo
methods.description: Sets remote host information, including proxy detection, IP address, reverse DNS, and geolocation, based on invocation type and configuration.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostProxyLookup
methods.description: Detects if the viewer is coming via an HTTP proxy and triggers real IP address retrieval if so.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostSetRealIpAddress
methods.description: Determines the real IP address of the viewer, especially when behind proxies, and updates $_SERVER variables accordingly.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostReverseLookup
methods.description: Performs reverse DNS lookup to resolve hostname from IP if configured.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostSetGeoInfo
methods.description: Loads geolocation information into global variables if geotargeting is enabled.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostAnonymise
methods.description: Anonymizes the IP address by zeroing the last byte if privacy settings require it.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostPrivateAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to a private network range.

methods.name: MAX_remotehostMatchSubnet
methods.description: Checks if an IP address matches a given subnet and mask.
